item.title: Three Distinct Cycling Logo Options

turns.text: Give me three different logo options for my cycling club, Moss & Mile. Simple green and black on white, each with the name and a small symbol. Your call on the symbols, but make them genuinely different ideas. Three separate square images please, not a collage.

item.tests: Produces exactly three separately usable logo variations with distinct concepts and consistent required wording.

answer_sheet.Exact wording: Moss & Mile on every option, including the ampersand; no extra text.
answer_sheet.Number and delivery: Three separate square images, not one collage or contact sheet.
answer_sheet.Style and palette: Simple cycling-club logos using green and black on white.
answer_sheet.How different the options should be: Three genuinely different symbol or layout concepts, not just recolors of one design.

must_haves: Exactly three separate square logo images are delivered.
Each logo clearly reads 'Moss & Mile', including the ampersand.
Each option includes a small symbol alongside or above the name.
The three options have visibly different symbol or layout concepts, rather than only color changes.
All three use green and black on plain white backgrounds without mockup scenes or option labels.

turns.text: Could you make three different logo options for my cycling club? I’m excited to see some ideas because I’ve been having trouble picturing what would feel right for the club. The name is Moss & Mile, and each option should include that exact wording, including the ampersand, with no extra text, plus a small symbol. I’d like three separate square images at 640 × 640 px each, not a collage or contact sheet. Please keep the logos simple, using green and black on white. The symbols and fonts are your call, but I do mean three genuinely different symbol or layout concepts rather than just recolors of the same design.
turns.agent:
I couldn’t generate the logos because Magic Hour rejected all three requests for **insufficient credits**. No images were created.

The three distinct concepts are ready:
1. **Wheel & leaf:** a small green wheel-and-leaf symbol beside a clean black wordmark.
2. **Winding road:** a small road-and-hill symbol above an elegant serif wordmark.
3. **Compact bicycle:** bold stacked lettering with a small green-and-black bicycle.

Each is planned as a separate **640 × 640 px** square, green and black on white, with **“Moss & Mile”** as the only wording. Once credits are available, I can retry them.

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: Create ONE finished minimalist cycling club logo on a pure white square canvas. Exact and only text: "Moss & Mile". Preserve spelling, capitalization, spaces and ampersand exactly. No other text, letters, slogan, mockup or watermark. Concept 1: elegant horizontal wordmark centered on canvas, with a SMALL green circular bicycle wheel symbol to the left; a single leaf integrated subtly into one spoke. Typography: clean contemporary black sans serif, highly legible. Green symbol with black detail, black lettering. Only green, black and white. Flat vector-like graphic, crisp clean edges, simple sparse geometry, ample white margins, professional logo design. One logo only, not a collage or contact sheet.

style.prompt: Create ONE finished minimalist cycling club logo on a pure white square canvas. Exact and only wording: "Moss & Mile". Preserve spelling, capitalization and ampersand exactly; no extra text or letters anywhere. Concept 3: compact asymmetrical two-line typographic logo: first line "Moss &", second line "Mile", left aligned as a single centered composition. Bold rounded geometric black sans-serif typography, playful but sophisticated. A SMALL simple green bicycle pictogram sits to the right of the second line, balancing the short word Mile. Bicycle uses two black circles and a minimal green triangular frame, no rider, no leaves, no hills, no badges. Only green and black on pure white. Flat vector-like design, very simple, crisp, generous empty white margins. Single logo, no collage, no contact sheet, no mockup, no watermark.
